name: Brainstorming / Ideation Session
description: Capture creative sessions, idea generation workshops, and collaborative problem-solving meetings with structured ideas, themes, and prioritized outcomes.

sections.title: Session Overview
sections.instruction: Summarize the problem statement, opportunity, or topic that was the focus of the brainstorm, and the goal or desired outcome of the session.

sections.title: Participants
sections.instruction: List all participants and their roles or departments. Note any facilitators or subject matter experts present.

sections.title: Context & Constraints
sections.instruction: Capture any background information, constraints, boundaries, or criteria that were established before ideation began (e.g., budget limits, timeline, must-haves, off-limits areas).

sections.title: Ideas Generated
sections.instruction: List all ideas surfaced during the session without filtering or judgment. Group by theme or category if themes emerged naturally.

sections.title: Top Ideas & Prioritization
sections.instruction: List the ideas that received the most interest, votes, or discussion. Note why each rose to the top and any early ranking or scoring.

sections.title: Key Themes & Insights
sections.instruction: Summarize any recurring themes, surprising insights, shared pain points, or patterns that emerged across multiple ideas.

sections.title: Parking Lot
sections.instruction: List ideas or topics that came up but were out of scope, deferred, or need more exploration before they can be evaluated.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: List actions to move promising ideas forward — research tasks, prototype requests, follow-up meetings, or owners assigned to explore specific ideas.
